correctness.rationale: Fubini establishes the operator volume identity, exact differential boundary conditions solve the resolvent, subtraction of cotangent partial fractions provides an absolutely convergent pole series, and signed pairwise dominance proves strict alternation for every index. Anchored normalization and Ehrhart integrality are explicit. An actual Python standard-library checker passed 12 independent exact volume comparisons, 16 rational polynomial volumes, 14 exact-ratio comparisons numerically, and 10 numerical spectral sums. Tests supplement, not replace, the symbolic proof.

originality.rationale: The exact fan-graph volume generating function, all-dimensional cotangent spectral sum and strict alternating-ratio theorem differ in mathematical invariant and implications from indexed same-graph facet data and from the existing open-ladder volume sequence. Aliaga 2021 studies extreme molecules and Alexander et al. 2019 study metric-space volume products; neither supplies this fan-volume formula. Sanyal–Stump 2017 study oriented poset constraints, and a 2020 general polytrope-volume algorithm does not give the family-level spectral sign theorem. Primary sources and accessible prior claims were compared, with residual unindexed-alias risk.
residual_risks: Older literature on transfer-integral volumes of distance-banded paths or under a polytope alias may contain an equivalent all-dimensional expression that was not indexed by available queries.
The classical cotangent partial fractions are established background, not a newly discovered operator theorem in isolation.

value.rationale: An exact trigonometric generating function and rigorously signed all-index convergence rate for the natural anchored dual volumes of every fan metric constitute a motivated infinite-family Banach geometric invariant. Its alternating ratios distinguish this family structurally from known open-ladder and equilateral cases. Both the object and the precise asymptotic claim are natural; this is not a parameter-renaming or isolated table recomputation.
